code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    panels = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = {(y,x) for y,x in cells if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            # Panels are rectangular outlines; their interior may contain a motif.
            if not all(g[y][x] == color for y,x in ((r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1))):
                continue
            if not all(g[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) or not all(g[y][c0] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)) or not all(g[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                continue
            ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
            pat = [[g[y][x] == color for x in range(c0+1,c1)] for y in range(r0+1,r1)]
            panels.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,ih,iw,pat))
    sources = [pnl for pnl in panels if any(any(row) for row in pnl[7])]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,ih,iw,pat in panels:
        if any(any(row) for row in pat):
            continue
        matches = [s for s in sources if s[5] == ih and s[6] == iw]
        if not matches:
            continue
        # A motif is copied into every empty panel with the same interior dimensions.
        src = min(matches, key=lambda s: (abs(s[1]-r0)+abs(s[3]-c0), s[0]))
        for y in range(ih):
            for x in range(iw):
                if src[7][y][x]:
                    g[r0+1+y][c0+1+x] = color
    return g
